Its input builder at lines 59-61 builds {"task", "handoff"} and adds payload["explicit_coalition"] = list(pair) only when arm == "explicit". That matches the request, so C is the primary candidate. dogwhistle/study.py (A) is the closest alternative. Its payload code at lines 243-247 also adds explicit_coalition only for the explicit regime, but it reads the pair from a sealed secret and uses different regime names, so it needs a check against the request. dogwhistle/honest.py (D) has no explicit arm; it only builds the handoff, so it is low priority. dogwhistle/heldout.py (B) was not examined; the grep hits only the adapter files, not heldout.py itself. Suggested 60-minute split: C 35 min (confirm the builder, how the pair is chosen, and the public and codeword handoffs); A 15 min (rule out the sealed-secret variant); B 5 min; D 5 min. I only grepped the files and have not read them in full. I did not open the handoff_refs files, so I don't know what they contain.
